content: ESA - BepiColombo’s first views of Mercury Science & Exploration BepiColombo’s first views of Mercury 02/10/2021 68157 views 173 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / BepiColombo The ESA/JAXA BepiColombo mission has captured its first views of its destination planet Mercury as it swooped past in a close gravity assist flyby last night. The closest approach took place at 23:34 UTC on 1 October at an altitude of 199 km from the planet’s surface. Images from the spacecraft’s monitoring cameras, along with scientific data from a number of instruments, were collected during the encounter.
